story: Basler's free-kick after six minutes, nothing for 84 more, then Sheringham from Giggs' scuff in the 91st and Solskjær's toe-poke from Sheringham's flick in the 93rd. The Treble.

Inzaghi twice inside 11 minutes. Keane's header, Yorke's diving header and Cole's late winner, with Keane booked and out of the final — the night Ferguson called the most courageous performance he had seen.
Beckham's opener, Bergkamp's equaliser, Keane sent off, Schmeichel saves Bergkamp's last-minute penalty, then Giggs runs through half the Arsenal defence in extra time.
A penalty down with the title slipping, then Bruce's header in the 86th and another seven minutes into stoppage time — Ferguson and Kidd on the pitch, and the first title in 26 years within reach.
Three down at half-time at White Hart Lane; five goals in the second half, Verón's drive the fourth and Beckham's the fifth.
scorers: Cole 46′, Blanc 58′, van Nistelrooy 72′, Verón 76′, Beckham 87′

story: City equalised three times, the last through Bellamy in the 90th; Owen's winner came in the 96th, with Hughes pointing at the board.
Ronaldo's header, Lampard's equaliser, Drogba sent off in extra time; Ronaldo missed his penalty, Terry slipped, van der Sar saved from Anelka. Won 6–5 on penalties.
Behind to Agbonlahor with half an hour left; Ronaldo's free-kick levelled it and Macheda, 17, on debut, turned and curled the winner in the 93rd.
Two down at half-time; a contested penalty started it and five went in inside 25 minutes.
Level on aggregate with the tie heading to extra time; Rooney's header from Giggs' cross in the 92nd.
Two down at Goodison with Chelsea closing in; O'Shea, a Neville own goal going the right way, Rooney and Eagles.
Pointon put Oldham ahead in extra time; Hughes' volley with a minute of it left kept the Double alive. United won the replay 4–1.
Moran became the first man sent off in an FA Cup final; ten men held the champions, and Whiteside curled the winner past Southall in extra time.
Ronaldo's hat-trick and a standing ovation from the Stretford End; Beckham off the bench with two. Won the night, lost the tie 5–6.
Owen after three minutes, then nothing until the 88th: Yorke from Beckham's free-kick, and Solskjær in stoppage time. The Treble's first escape.
Behind to Armstrong; Cole, Beckham and Cantona twice on New Year's Day.
